Range 30 feet

Targets 1 creature

Frequency once per day

Saving Throw Will

Duration 1 minute

Punish a target for attacking anyone but you.

The target must succeed at a Will save against your class DC or, for the duration, take a -1 circumstance penalty to attack rolls and damage rolls against anyone other than you (-2 on a critical failure). This is a mental effect. It isn't jealousy. It's just clarity about who matters.
